thread.title: Amazon Closes In on Top Market-Value Spot - Barron's

author: Jon Swartz
title: Amazon Closes In on Top Market-Value Spot - Barron's
text:
By Jon Swartz April 26, 2018 6:19 p.m. ET Illustration: Getty Images Don't look now, but Amazon.com (AMZN) is quickly closing in on Apple (AAPL) for the top spot in market value.
Fresh off a bang-up quarter that sent its shares up 7% in late trading , the e-commerce and cloud-computing giant is worth about $807 billion, based on the after-hours price of $1,620 and share count of 498 million, as my colleague Andrew Bary points out.
Apple, which has held the top spot, is at $833 billion, according to Bloomberg.
This means Amazon, whose stock is up 30% this year despite taunting tweets from President Donald Trump , could beat Apple, Google parent Alphabet (GOOGL) and Microsoft (MSFT) to become the first $1 trillion company. Amazon will achieve the mythical figure if its shares top $2,000, note analysts such as Monnes Crespi analyst Brian White .
